purpose: Frozen held-out H12 confirmation of the independently transferred d24 MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate on METR-LA and PEMS-BAY.
research_question: On two independent non-graph traffic-speed benchmarks at H12, is the frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate non-inferior to its registered primary nonlinear comparators while retaining measured prediction-only latency advantages over named baselines?
evidence_boundary: The selection phase is validation-only. Test metrics are generated only by frozen confirmation phases and are read once after every phase passes strict validation; no test value selects an arm, epoch, architecture, lambda, or hyperparameter.
claim_boundary: This release can support only the registered METR-LA/PEMS-BAY non-graph H12 claim family. It does not establish graph-aware, long-horizon, universal time-series superiority, or a causal AutoCon-loss accuracy effect.

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The d24 MambaTSv3 AutoCon architecture and lambda=0.001 are frozen from the independent METR-LA/PEMS-BAY H12 validation protocol; this phase verifies only the executable contract before test release.

confirmation_contract.test_read_gate: Aggregate only after every registered phase validator succeeds and test metrics cannot change the matrix.
confirmation_contract.independence_note: Forecast windows and channels are not inferential replicates; seed-level paired contrasts are the uncertainty unit.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share the timestamp-first loader, chronological ratio split, features, sequence length, horizon, maximum epochs, patience, optimizer, scheduler, batch, and normalization. d_model/d_ff are frozen at the candidate protocol.
capacity_fairness_contract.external_baseline_boundary: External baselines are fixed same-source references; parameter and latency counts are reported separately and unmatched capacity differences are not attributed to the Mamba operator.

accuracy_claim_contract.boundary: The primary claim is restricted to TimeMixer and plain MambaTSv3. All other baselines are mandatory descriptive rows.

phases.name: selection_metro_pemsbay_d24_candidate_validation
phases.purpose: Validation-only contract check for the frozen d24 MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate.

phases.name: confirmatory_metro_pemsbay_d24_candidate_test
phases.purpose: Frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate held-out test phase.

phases.name: confirmatory_metro_pemsbay_strong_baselines_test
phases.purpose: Fixed same-source reference models under the identical held-out test contract.

statistical_gate.paired_effect: seed-level log(MSE_candidate / MSE_baseline) and raw scaled-MSE delta
statistical_gate.interpretation: A registered dataset/comparator cell is non-inferior only when the one-sided paired seed-level upper bound is no worse than 1.02; otherwise it is inconclusive or unfavorable.
statistical_gate.small_n_warning: Five seeds remain modest and do not support universal claims.

resource_contract.efficiency_claim_gate: Only report speed against a named comparator when the corresponding accuracy gate passes; never claim speed over DLinear/NLinear without a separate qualified analysis.

prelaunch_gates: verify METR-LA and PEMS-BAY hashes and exact 76-job expansion
keep test metrics out of selection
run all phases under the immutable launch sidecar
read test metrics only after all strict phase validators pass
